suspect:surgeon_graves: Surgeon Graves rolled his sleeves down before presenting himself on deck. His hands were clean but the ink under his nails had not yet dried.
event:halyard_strangling: The signal halyard was looped twice around the neck and pulled from behind. The knot at the base was a surgeon's bend.
motive:prize_money_fraud: The prize ledger showed a shortfall of four hundred pounds across three captures. The false accounts were kept in a separate book in the surgery cabin.
suspect:bosun_flint: Bosun Flint stood at the rail with his belaying pin in hand. He had quarrelled with Cole over ration weights the previous watch.
suspect:captain_hale: Captain Hale kept the prize ledger locked in his cabin chest. He claimed he had not opened it since the last port call.
suspect:navigator_reid: Navigator Reid charted a course two points west of the agreed heading. His compass case held a folded note that was not a bearing.
suspect:powder_monkey_sam: Sam carried rum to the gun deck at the start of the middle watch. He said he heard nothing from the hold below.
suspect:first_mate_darcy: First Mate Darcy had the watch and was responsible for all movement on deck. His log entry for the middle watch is four lines shorter than usual.
suspect:carpenter_hook: Carpenter Hook had patched a seam in the orlop hold that afternoon. His tools were still below when the body was found.
location:gun_deck: The gun deck runs the length of the ship between the main hatch and the stern. The lanterns were doused for the middle watch.
location:orlop_hold: The orlop hold sits below the gun deck and holds cargo and stores. Cole's body lay between two prize chests with the halyard around his neck.
location:surgery_cabin: The surgery cabin is aft of the hold, separated by a canvas screen. A desk holds ink, quill, and two ledgers bound in different leather.
location:main_deck: The main deck is open to the sky and swept by wind. The rigging overhead creaks with each roll of the hull.
location:captains_cabin: The captain's cabin holds a chart table and a locked sea chest. The key hangs on a cord around Captain Hale's neck.
location:rigging_platform: The rigging platform sits thirty feet above the main deck. A signal halyard runs from the platform to a cleat on the starboard rail.
location:forecastle: The forecastle holds the crew's hammocks and the watch bell. The bell was struck at four bells but no one answered from the hold.
location:stores_locker: The stores locker is bolted from outside and holds rum, biscuit, and coin. The bolt was found drawn back at dawn muster.
object:prize_ledger: The prize ledger records the value of each captured cargo by date and port. Three entries show sums lower than the manifest totals.
object:signal_halyard: A signal halyard was cut from the starboard rigging and found in the hold. The fibre matches the rope stock used for signalling.
object:false_accounts: A second set of accounts was found in the surgery cabin desk. The figures are written in the same hand as the prize ledger corrections.
object:watch_bell: The watch bell was struck at four bells of the middle watch. No one reported hearing it from below.
object:rum_ration_log: The rum ration log shows a discrepancy of eight pints over the past fortnight. The missing rum was not reported to the captain.
object:neck_bruise: The bruise around Cole's neck shows a double loop consistent with a halyard. The pressure was applied from behind and above.
object:coin_pouch: A coin pouch was found beneath the surgery cabin floorboard. The coins include gold from three different prize captures.
object:belaying_pin: A belaying pin from the main deck rail shows a fresh dent. The dent does not match any recent rigging work.
object:ink_and_quill: The quill on the surgery desk matches the ink used in the false accounts. The nib width is consistent with the ledger corrections.
object:locked_chest: The captain's sea chest was found with its wax seal broken. The lid showed no tool marks but the lock had been turned.
object:torn_manifest: A cargo manifest was found torn in half in the stores locker. The torn section listed cargo values from the last prize.
object:compass_case: Navigator Reid's compass case held a folded note listing three port agents. One name appears in the false accounts.
object:bloodied_rope: A length of rope with blood on one end was found coiled behind a barrel in the hold. The coil was left-handed.
emotion:steady_nerve: He answered each question without shifting his weight. His voice was level and his gaze held the middle distance.
emotion:blunt_denial: He struck the rail with his palm and said he had nothing to do with it. His denial came before the question was finished.
emotion:clipped_tone: Every answer was precisely two sentences. He did not elaborate and he did not look at the body.
emotion:averted_look: He turned to face the sea when asked about the chest. His hand moved to the key on his cord.
emotion:false_grief: He removed his cap and pressed it to his chest. His condolence was fluent and his eyes moved to the surgery cabin door.
emotion:quiet_rage: He said nothing when shown the ration log. His jaw tightened and he looked toward the rigging.
modifier:rope_coiled_wrong: The rope in the hold was coiled left-handed. Sailors coil right-handed by training; a surgeon would not know the convention.
modifier:ink_smudge: An ink smudge on the false accounts matches the ink on Graves's right forefinger. The smudge is still tacky.
modifier:lantern_doused: All gun deck lanterns were doused for the middle watch as standard. The hold was completely dark after the last bell.
modifier:figures_wrong: Three prize entries in the ledger show values lower than the corresponding manifests. The differences total four hundred pounds.
modifier:hatch_unbolted: The orlop hatch was found unbolted at dawn. Standing orders require it bolted during the night watch.
modifier:knot_surgeons: The knot at the base of the halyard loop is a surgeon's bend. It is not used in standard rigging practice.
modifier:wax_seal_broken: The wax seal on the captain's chest was broken cleanly. The wax colour matches a stick found in the surgery cabin.
modifier:fibre_match: The fibres from the halyard match the rope stock on the rigging platform. The stock is used only for signal lines.
modifier:pin_dent: The dent on the belaying pin is consistent with a downward blow. No rigging task would produce this mark.
modifier:gold_dust_residue: Gold dust was found on the inside of the coin pouch and on the false accounts. The dust matches gold from the last prize.
action:ledger_doctored: Three entries in the prize ledger were altered to show reduced cargo values. The original figures are visible beneath the overwriting.
action:halyard_cut: A signal halyard was cut from the starboard rigging between eight bells and four bells. The cut was made with a sharp blade.
action:hold_entered: Someone entered the orlop hold through the unbolted hatch during the middle watch. The hatch bolt was found drawn back.
action:chest_opened: The captain's sea chest was opened using a wax impression of the lock. The impression was made from the key on the captain's cord.
action:body_moved: The body was positioned between two prize chests after death. The drag marks on the hold floor run from the hatch ladder.
action:rum_served: Rum was served to the gun deck watch at the start of the middle watch. Sam carried the measure and poured for six men.
action:manifest_checked: The torn manifest was checked against the prize ledger entries. The values on the manifest are higher than those recorded.
action:accounts_compared: The false accounts in the surgery cabin were compared with the prize ledger. The handwriting matches on seven of nine criteria.
action:rope_discarded: The bloodied rope was coiled and hidden behind a barrel in the hold. The blood had not fully dried when found.
time:middle_watch: The middle watch runs from midnight to four in the morning. The crew on watch numbered eight, including the first mate.
time:bell_struck: The watch bell was struck at two-hour intervals. Four bells sounded at 02:00 and no reply came from below.
time:dawn_muster: Dawn muster was called at six. The quartermaster did not answer and the search began.
time:cargo_count: A cargo count was scheduled for the morning before port. Cole had requested it to verify the prize totals.
time:port_arrival: The ship was due in port within three days. At port, the prize shares would be calculated from the ledger.
motive:gold_skim: Graves had skimmed gold from three prize captures over four months. The hidden coin pouch held his accumulated share.
motive:share_dispute: Navigator Reid claimed his prize share was calculated short. He had raised the matter with Cole the previous week.
motive:audit_prevention: Cole had requested a full cargo count before port. The count would have exposed the discrepancy between the ledger and the manifests.
motive:command_ambition: First Mate Darcy believed the quartermasters authority exceeded his station. He had petitioned the captain for expanded watch powers.
motive:old_score: Carpenter Hook had served under Cole on a previous ship. A dispute over timber stores had ended with Hook receiving twelve lashes.
witness:lookout: The lookout saw no one on the rigging platform during the middle watch. He was facing forward and the platform is aft.
witness:helmsman: The helmsman held the wheel from midnight to four. He heard the bell struck but no sounds from below deck.
witness:cook: The cook rose at five to prepare the morning meal. He found the stores locker bolt drawn and the rum measure unwashed.
witness:gunner: The gunner slept on the gun deck and woke at dawn muster. He reported a sound from the hold at approximately three bells.
witness:cabin_boy: The cabin boy delivered coffee to the captain at five. He noticed the surgery cabin lamp was still burning.
event:quartermaster_cole_discovered: Quartermaster Cole was found in the orlop hold between two prize chests. The signal halyard was wrapped around his neck and his eyes were open.
event:cargo_inspection: The cargo inspection was ordered by Cole to verify prize values before port. The inspection was to begin at dawn muster.
